text:
dev-deploy-bot: RELEASE CHECK FAILED 1 env-parity-check blocked promotion. Secret mismatch: /prod/inference/kvcache encoding != staging (key 'inference-kv'). Promotion paused.

alice: ugh. what's different?

ben: staging values are base64 JSON, prod has hex blobs. new runtime in v2.1.0 expects base64 -> JSON. prod startup hitting 500s when cache loads.

carmen: confirmed sample: staging 'eyJpdiI...' (base64), prod '0a1b2c3d...'(hex). looks like an old migration wrote hex to prod only.

dave: release pins model-serving image to v2.1.0; if we push, some instances will fail on warmup.

erin: options: immediate rollback to v2.0.4, secret backfill (re-encode prod -> base64), or ship runtime tolerant parser. Backfill needs KMS decrypt/re-encrypt and a short write window.

ben: runtime change risky. rollback quickest. backfill low-risk but needs ops window and throttling.

carmen: I can run a backfill job that detects hex vs base64 and re-writes secrets as base64 JSON. need deploy perms and ~20m throttled window. I'll write a dry-run first.

sre-oncall: we can give a 30m change window in 40m from now. We can also watch SecretManager rate limits.

dave: alternative: pin canary traffic to v2.0.4 (0.1%) while backfill runs; then flip to v2.1.0 after verification. less user impact.

erin: agreed. I'll own the backfill image and playbook. Carmen owns secret script and runbook. Dave open the canary pin PR.

carmen: script pseudocode:
```bash
# dry-run then apply
python backfill_kvcache.py --project prod --kms-key projects/.../keys/inference --dry-run
```
Logs will show sample conversions before apply.

ben: add OPS-1192 to audit annotations and release notes.

alice: timeline: we're 25m into the window. if we can land pin PR + start backfill within 15m, proceed. else rollback.

dave: opening PR: branch pin-canary/v2.0.4 -> release (draft). https://github.com/redwood-inference/release/pull/4902

erin: running local dry-run, will push tool image in ~8m.

carmen: will run prod backfill with --throttle=10r/s and monitor. watch: https://logs.redwood/team/inference/backfill/3959876543

dev-deploy-bot: ACTION: canary pin PR merged; canary traffic pinned to v2.0.4 (0.1%). Promotion paused.

ben: changelog updated with OPS-1192 and note: 'Hotfix: kvcache encoding parity backfill to enable v2.1.0'.

alice: if backfill fails we rollback. Dave, you will trigger rollback?

dave: yes. rollback playbook ready to revert pins and promote v2.0.4.

erin: dry-run success, pushing image gcr.io/redwood/secret-tools:20260315-rc1.

carmen: applying throttled backfill now. will report progress and final status in this thread.

sre-oncall: monitoring started. will escalate if 2% error spike >5m.

[20m later]

carmen: backfill completed across all secret shards, sampled loads show base64 JSON and model-serving nodes warmed successfully.

dev-deploy-bot: HOLD LIFTED: canary ramp scheduled. After monitoring window, canary will be ramped to 100% -> v2.1.0.

alice: great work. keep postmortem notes short: root cause, fix, lessons (add parity check to preflight), and release note blurb.

ben: done. OPS-1192 added to final release notes.

erin: closing images and runbook updates pushed.

dave: will flip canary according to deploybot plan if no anomalies in 30m.

dev-deploy-bot: final status to be posted after monitoring window.
